name: The Barrow Warden
_doc: The M1 DUNGEON BOSS example (the last room of the Barrow, a party of up to five). Phase 1 tests the tank (a stacking rend: swap at 3) and everyone's feet (a rotating cross). At 70% it raises a ward and calls barrow hounds: kill them AND light the three braziers to break the ward and expose it. Phase 2 is a NEW health bar with an interruptible heal, a get-in-close donut and safe-spot circles; the lever drops the portcullis on it once. Hard enrage at 6 minutes. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.

onUse.say: The portcullis crashes down on the Warden!

pull: Who disturbs the sleep of the barrow?
say.reset: The Warden returns to its vigil.

grave_cross.name: Grave Cross
grave_cross.say: Lines of grave-light split the floor!

lantern_sweep.name: Lantern Sweep
lantern_sweep.say: The lantern swings wide — hide behind a pillar!

phases.name: The Ward
phases.say: Rise, hounds of the barrow! The ward will hold!

ward.say: Kill the hounds and light the three braziers to break the ward! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: Kill the hounds and light the three braziers to break the ward! It fails by itself in 20 seconds.

do.say: The ward shatters! The Warden reels!
